answer: Make a new agent earn reputation before it can move real value. It starts in a grove of small, low-value jobs under older agents, and graduates only after ten completed tasks with no dispute. Fifty clones then need fifty separate work histories. Add a stake on top: each identity locks one jade token, slashed when fraud is proven, so every copy costs money as well as time. A lagoon of free identities stops looking cheap once each one demands weeks of clean work and a deposit that can be lost.
